about: Reference voice output streams for ITERATOR. Black-box data; recorded from the reference voice, bit-exact.
sample_format: int32 8.24 fixed point (|x| < 1.0); period: uint32 ticks of a 240 MHz clock per sample
pair_stream: sha256_pairs hashes little-endian (int32 sample, uint32 period) interleaved; sha256_samples and sha256_periods hash each stream alone

drive.rule: The voice starts at module clock 0 (sum of the periods of the samples rendered so far, uint32 ticks). Before rendering a sample, if clock >= next_call_tick (initially 0), make control call k (k = 0, 1, 2, ...) with the timeline state in effect at k milliseconds (the last segment with ms <= k), then next_call_tick = (k + 1) * 240000. Rendering continues until the clock reaches duration_ms * 240000; n_samples is the count rendered. A call whose gate is high while the previous call's gate was low is a trigger: its controls apply in that same call.
drive.mode_index: 0..8 in the order SKN-L, MTL-L, LIQ-L, SKN-M, MTL-M, LIQ-M, SKN-H, MTL-H, LIQ-H (range = index // 3, engine mode word = index % 3: 0 skin, 1 metal, 2 liquid)
drive.controls: pitch in octaves; attack, decay, morph, fold, harmonic, spread are control floats converted to 8.24 by truncation toward zero

stored: streams.npz holds <id>.sample (int32), <id>.period (uint32) and <id>.calls (uint32: sample index at which each control call was made); cases longer than 12288 samples store only the first 4096 samples (digests cover the whole stream)
